title: Human turn panel: tell the player when typed text will be spoken instead of run as an action

sections.what: In the human turn composer, a typed line whose first word is not in the 58-entry VERBS list is sent as speech. Show the player that before they commit, instead of letting 'walk over to the counter' be said aloud by the character.
sections.why: Verified in human-turn-composer.ts parseCmd: line 171 returns { speech: t } when the first word is not in VERBS, and buildPayload then sends it as p.speech with the current volume. 'walk' is not in VERBS ('go' and 'approach' are), so the intent becomes dialogue with no warning. The behavior is documented in the code comment ('Unknown verbs become speech') so this is a feedback gap, not a parser bug. Live reproduction in the browser is still to be done and recorded before closing.
sections.how: In the composer, on input in #htc-do, run parseCmd and, when the result has speech but no action, show a one-line hint under the field: the text will be said aloud, plus the closest known verbs. Leave parseCmd and the payload untouched. Keep the hint out of the way when the field is empty or starts with a volume word (scream, shout, whisper), which are deliberate speech.

acceptance.text: Typing 'walk to the bar' in the do field shows a hint that it will be spoken, naming at least one real verb.
Typing 'go north' or 'take sword' shows no hint.
Committed payloads are byte-identical to before for the same input.
